metadata.description: Universal Loomground skill packages, installable on Claude, Codex, and generic skill hosts.

plugins.name: loomground-deontic
plugins.description: Transcribe a natural-language norm into a verified deontic formula: split it into modality (O/P/F), bearer, and action; classify the Hohfeldian incident; resolve a 'right' as a claim or a liberty; validate with a bundled stdlib engine; and flag candidate conflicts. Transcribes and flags, never infers or resolves.

plugins.name: loomground-governance
plugins.description: Express an AI-governance requirement as a verified Loomground policy-graph patch: draft the .lg patch, litmus-classify each requirement as expressible, policy, or host, and validate with the bundled validation engine. Non-normative companion skill to the Loomground standard.

plugins.name: loomground-ingest
plugins.description: Drive the Loomground ingest plane: dispatch a multimodal artifact to the registered ingester, lower it to a dimensioned subgraph (5D mental model / nD governance) with provenance and quarantine semantics, dry-run by default, and write to versum only through the gated writer once that seam is built.

plugins.name: loomground-solver
plugins.description: Analytic and probabilistic reasoning skills over the Loomground Solver kernel: model opponents, track probabilities, analyse strategy, estimate liability, assess litigation risk, analyse risks, and advise on optional add-ons.

plugins.name: loomground-versum
plugins.description: Loomground's human-gated knowledge-graph write path, concept-neighbour organiser, mental-model engine, and the research→graph enrichment loop, plus the read-only KG cockpit and conversational query surface over the graph.
